name: IT Creations NVIDIA GPU and accelerator catalogue
notes: Fetched 2026-10-03. IT Creations publishes a structured accelerator catalogue: 'NVIDIA Workstation GPUs (35)', 'NVIDIA Datacenter GPUs (30)', 'TITAN (2)', 'GeForce (22)', indexed by GPU Architecture (Hopper 2, Ampere 22, Ada Lovelace 16, Blackwell 10, Volta 4, Turing 9, Pascal 9, Kepler 7, Maxwell 5, Fermi 2, Tesla 3). Individual product pages exist for RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition, RTX PRO 6000/5000/4500/4000 Blackwell, RTX 6000/5000/4500/4000/2000 Ada, RTX A6000. Useful as evidence that a specialist ex-datacenter reseller carries a broad accelerator SKU set. NOT PRICED: product pages are quote-on-request and no price was published in the extracted HTML.
